name: phishing_check
description: Phishing & suspicious-link analysis (heuristics, not antivirus): checks a URL or pasted email for homograph/lookalike domains, IP-address hosts, URL shorteners, urgent-pressure language, credential-bait phrasing, and mismatched link text.
